records: The CFTC July 31, 2026 FCM report is a month-end selected-data snapshot filed by September 1, not current October data. CFTC says published data are not revised for later amended information.

CFTC adjusted net capital and customer assets in segregation are FCM-level regulatory measures. Customer assets include money, securities and property across product types; the report does not identify XRP, digital-asset collateral or any asset-level composition.

Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC and Coinbase Financial Markets Inc. are separate FCM legal entities with different product/customer mixes. Their July capital and segregated-fund values are not directly comparable measures of consolidated group size, market share or XRP-related capital.

Hidden Road's audited December 31, 2025 statement is entity-specific and dated. Its $39.019B total assets are dominated by repo/reverse-repo financing; this is not $39B of free cash, deployable equity or XRP inventory. The $100M Ripple-parent repo is a U.S. Treasury financing transaction, not XRP collateral.

The SEC statement's $70M post-year-end parent capital contribution through February 26, 2026 is parent support to the FCM, not a customer collateral deposit or evidence of XRP purchases. The filing does not separately identify XRP; absence of a token line item does not prove no client XRP was held in custody/segregation.

The CFTC FCM report and SEC statement provide no asset-level breakdown of customer collateral, collateral posted to Bitnomial, XRP balances, customer-level margin utilization, turnover or net market purchases. Actual XRP demand remains unknown.
